title: Pake Handling Tools 55-Gallon Heavy-Duty Steel Drum Dolly with 8 Phenolic Swivel Casters (2,000 lb Capacity)
description: Transport drums with the Heavy-Duty Drum Dolly. This drum dolly has a round steel frame and eight swivel caster wheels, and can be used to transport a 55-gallon drum that weighs up to 2,000 lb. The dolly is made of steel, which is stronger than aluminum and more resistant to fractures than cast iron. The eight caster wheels swivel for maneuverability, measure 1-1/4 inches wide and 4 inches in diameter each, and are made of phenolic, which is resistant to impacts, wear, and rust. This dolly has a load capacity of 2,000 lb. and weighs 26 lb.
